name: Climber (women)
description: Typical female professional climber: CP/W' fitted to the median (P50) record power profile of Mateo-March et al. 2022, which follows the data (women's time trialists have higher relative power over 10-60 min). Mass scaled from Ebert et al. 2005; CdA: the Garcia-Lopez et al. 2014 value (0.237 m^2) scaled by frontal area.
